en.title: Twilight's Animated Midnight Sun Series Gets Epic Two-Season Netflix Order
en.summary: Get ready to revisit Forks from a whole new angle. Lionsgate has officially confirmed that the highly anticipated animated adaptation of Stephenie Meyer's *Midnight Sun* has landed a massive two-season commitment from Netflix.
en.body:
Fans of the *Twilight* universe, prepare yourselves: the saga is expanding in a significant way. Lionsgate has dropped a major update regarding the long-gestating animated series based on Stephenie Meyer's *Midnight Sun*. In a rare display of confidence before the first frame even airs, Netflix has committed to not one, but *two* full seasons of the upcoming show. This substantial order underscores the immense faith both Netflix and Lionsgate have in the project's potential to reignite passion for the iconic vampire romance.

The animated *Midnight Sun* series will retell the beloved story of Bella Swan and Edward Cullen's intense romance, but this time, exclusively through Edward's brooding, introspective perspective. The companion novel, released in 2020, offered a deep dive into his internal struggles and his fascination with Bella, providing rich material for an episodic adaptation. The confirmation of a two-season order came directly from Kevin Beggs, Chairman of the Lionsgate Television Group, during a recent earnings call. He emphasized that Meyer's own enthusiasm for television, particularly animation, was a driving force behind this adaptation.

> "Stephenie and her team are very hands-on, really running the process along with us at Netflix."

Beggs further elaborated on Lionsgate's high expectations, viewing the series as a crucial "continuation and expansion" of the *Twilight* universe. This approach suggests that the animation will not just be a simple retelling but aims to delve deeper into the established lore and characters, potentially exploring nuances previously left untouched. The studio believes the existing fanbase is "desperate for more authentic content," and this animated series is poised to deliver just that, offering a fresh yet familiar entry point for both long-time devotees and new viewers.

## A Bold Move for a Beloved Franchise

This significant upfront commitment from Netflix is far from typical. The streaming giant usually opts for a single-season order, gauging audience reception before greenlighting further installments. A two-season guarantee right out of the gate speaks volumes about the perceived marketability and creative strength of the *Midnight Sun* adaptation. It suggests that executives have seen enough in the development stages to be certain of its appeal and narrative potential. For fans who have longed for new *Twilight* content, this news is a thrilling validation that their passion is recognized and rewarded, promising a substantial, well-supported series rather than a tentative experiment.

## What's Next

Production for the **Midnight Sun** animated series is reportedly set to begin in August 2026 in Los Angeles, with a run planned through May 2027. While specific release dates for either season have not yet been announced, this production timeline indicates that audiences can likely expect the first season to arrive sometime in late 2027 or early 2028. With Stephenie Meyer herself deeply involved as an executive producer, alongside a team of experienced industry professionals, the animated *Twilight* series is positioned to be a major event for fans worldwide.

Lionsgate has revealed that the animated adaptation of Stephenie Meyer’s Midnight Sun  has a two-season commitment from Netflix, giving the long-gestating  Twilight  series a rare upfront vote of confidence before a single frame has hit the service. As first unveiled  all the way back in September 2024 , Netflix and Lionsgate are teaming up on an episodic animated adaptation of  Midnight Sun , Meyer’s 2020 companion novel that retells the events of  Twilight  from the perspective of Edward Cullen. The latest update came during Lionsgate’s Q2 2027 earnings call on November 5th, where Kevin Beggs, Chairman of the Lionsgate Television Group, confirmed the size of the order while discussing the studio’s plans for the  Twilight  franchise. Beggs explained that Meyer’s love of television, and animation in particular, “really led directly to the adaptation of  Midnight Sun ,” before adding: “That’s a 2-season adult animation order at Netflix. Stephenie and her team are very hands-on, really running the process along with us at Netflix.” Beggs went on to say that Lionsgate has “high expectations” for the series and sees it as a “continuation and expansion” of the  Twilight  universe. Earlier in the same call, Lionsgate’s Motion Picture Group chairman Adam Fogelson said the studio knows the  Twilight  audience is “desperate for more authentic content,” and that conversations with Meyer about the franchise are ongoing on the film side too. Why does a two-season order matter? Netflix typically orders new series one season at a time, waiting to see how a show performs before committing to more. Multi-season upfront orders are generally reserved for projects the streamer has real confidence in, and for animation, where seasons can take years to produce, it’s a big deal. Locking in two seasons now means the production can keep rolling without a lengthy pause waiting on a renewal decision, which should help shorten the gap between seasons. That’s something Lionsgate is clearly thinking about. On the same call, Beggs discussed how getting shows back on a predictable timetable is “becoming more and more important” in the streaming era, pointing to Netflix renewing  The Hunting Wives  for a third season before its second had even premiered. It also raises an interesting question about pacing.  Midnight Sun  is a hefty book (it’s considerably longer than  Twilight  itself), so a two-season split for a single novel suggests the series will be taking its time with Edward’s version of events.
